prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1180; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with a rear-end collision that occurred while our client was stopped in traffic. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

Finally, we request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, recorded statements, claim notes, and any repair or total-loss appraisal records. Please ensure that no such material is altered, discarded, or repaired until our investigation is complete. We look forward to your prompt written response.
